protocol.windows: 8 s warmup, six subsequent two-second postRender windows
caveats: Desktop software renderer, not Android hardware
Fixed camera, not flight or import throughput
Online terrain/imagery timing can differ between sequential runs
Existing metrics exclude frame intervals at least 250 ms
